name: Nib Studio
description: Open a folder on your computer to edit, compare, search and preview its files in a browser tab. Works offline; nothing is uploaded.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; frame-src 'self'
